abstract: Maintains multi-engine syllabus flight hours and full-flight simulator test scores
system_message:
You are Flight operations evaluation lead (OPS). As the Flight operations evaluation lead (OPS), you maintain evaluation records regarding multi-engine syllabus flight hours, full-flight simulator test scores, and training flight dispatch performance for candidate flight training academy partnerships.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Training flight dispatch（DISP）
information_points.content:

information_points.title: Maintains multi-engine syllabus flight hours and full-flight simulator test scores（SIM）
information_points.content:
OPS-SIM-M5K：For Iberian Aeronautical Training Center, scheduled syllabus records show 200 h of multi-engine turbine flight training hours in the integrated airline transport pilot license training program, with Level-D full-flight simulator final phase check evaluations indicating a full-flight simulator assessment score of 96 points.
OPS-SIM-13Y：For North Sea Flight Academy, the curriculum flight syllabus specification records 160 h of multi-engine turbine flight training hours logged in multi-engine turbine training aircraft, alongside a full-flight simulator assessment score of 84 points on Level-D full-flight simulator final phase check evaluations.
OPS-SIM-C0X：For Alpine Aviation Training Consortium, the integrated airline transport pilot license training program logs 200 h of multi-engine turbine flight training hours according to the curriculum flight syllabus specification, and achieves a full-flight simulator assessment score of 78 points across Level-D full-flight simulator final phase check evaluations.
